message:
Rank Glyph Solver loadouts by the next Reality's iM and jM caps

Dual and Imaginary Machine amounts only fill toward their current caps, so
every loadout reached the same amount. The caps the next Reality would set
(shown on the Reality button) are what loadouts change, so rank by those.
